title: The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin before 5.0.0 does not validate and escape some of its shortcode…
description: The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin versions prior to 5.0.0 contain a vulnerability where certain shortcode attributes are not properly validated or escaped before being output on pages or posts. This flaw allows users with contributor-level permissions or higher to execute stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
